notes.title: Cubactory is joining the Automation Fest from July 14 to 21!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2816490/Cubactory/

Are you someone who enjoys optimizing systems, fine-tuning every cog, and creating increasingly efficient production chains? [b]Then you can't miss Cubactory during Steam's Automation Fest[/b], which runs from July 14 to 21. Download the demo and explore the basics of the game while designing your own custom cube factory.

Since Cubactory's participation in Steam Next Fest last June, [b]the demo has been updated and the start tutorial has been improved[/b]. A presentation has also been added to make all the game mechanics much clearer.

And remember, [b]you can now add Cubactory to your Steam wishlist[/b] and join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FdGdv8EUFnx][b]Discord community [/b][/url]to share strategies, designs, and feedback.

See you at the Automation Fest!

notes.title: Cubactory joins the Steam Next Fest on June 9th!
notes.notes:
Are you a fan of logic games, automation, and getting your head screwed up to create perfect systems? Then you'll love Cubactory. [b]From June 9th (at 16h CEST // 10h PDT) to June 16th we are joining the Steam Next Fest[/b] with a demo so you can try the main mechanics of the game before its release, remember that you can already add Cubactory to your [b]Wishlist on Steam[/b] and join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/A78a3vSpYt]official Discord[/url][/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2816490/Cubactory/

Cubactory is not just another factory game:[b] here you build objects piece by piece, combining, cutting, rotating and merging colored cubes to form unique voxel shape[/b]s. In the meantime, your modular factory grows into a perfect machine, ready to fulfill increasingly complex and challenging orders.

Mark your calendar for June 9th, install the demo, and start challenging your imagination.

[b]See you at the Steam Next Fest![/b]
